description: This Dart source file defines the DeviceTokenScreen widget in a Flutter app, responsible for displaying the Firebase Cloud Messaging device token, allowing users to copy it or refresh it. It manages loading states, handles token retrieval via a Firebase messaging service, and provides UI elements such as progress indicators and snackbars.

classes.name: DeviceTokenScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the device's FCM token and allows the user to refresh or copy it.

classes.name: _DeviceTokenScreenState
classes.description: State class for DeviceTokenScreen, manages loading state, token fetching, copying, and UI rendering.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers token loading.

methods.name: _loadToken
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the device token from Firebase Messaging and updates UI state accordingly.

methods.name: _copyToken
methods.description: Copies the current token to the clipboard and shows a snackbar notification.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including the app bar, status messages, token display, and action buttons.
